text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah, first place!!
That's what Big Sis Hishi Ama can do!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats a real, serious showdown!
And winning it feels even better.
choice_data_list: That run really got me pumped up!
Let's train even harder to prepare for those tough opponents!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right!? ...Heheh,
getting praised really does feel great!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing gets your blood pumping more
than blowing right past a strong opponent!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When you're competing head-to-head, the other person's fighting spirit really pierces right through you.
That feeling of "I won't lose, I'm not giving an inch"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Two unyielding wills clashing until a victor emerges...
Now that's the true thrill of a race!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~, I can't wait for the next showdown!
I'm gonna blow right past everyone and leave 'em in the dust again!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "That's it, exactly that! You really get it, Train-dude!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"The more I win, the stronger the folks I get to throw down with!
Thinking about that makes me can't wait for practice!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Right now, whether it's 100 slope sprints or a 100km open-water swim, I could pull it off—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Bring on the special training!!!
I'll push past my limits and get stronger, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, formidable foes.
Big Sis Hishi Ama will take you all on!!!
